settings.editor: We provide a range of clinical and support services for patients in the comfort of their home. Home health care is more convenient, less expensive, and just as effective as the care received in the hospital or a nursing home. Our clinical team of highly trained nurses, therapists and other providers work with the patient, their family, and their physician on a personalized treatment plan. Based on the patient's needs, we provide specialty services, as well as care coordination, patient education on self-management, health promotion and disease prevention, medications, and lifestyle modifications for optimal wellness

tabs.tab_content:
Mobile Medical LA works with major pharmacies to increase the quality of patient care and reduce hospital stays and readmissions. We offer flexible contracts to meet the needs of every patient, physician, and healthcare network. Our services include but are not limited to:

  • Total Parental Nutrition (TPN)
  • Antibiotics
  • Pain Management
  • Immunoglobulin (IVIG)
  • Hydration
  • Antiemetic
  • Antiviral Therapy
  • Antifungal Therapy
  • Injectables

settings.editor: MMLA clinical research staff will coordinate and oversee the homecare nursing services from its corporate office located in Inglewood, California. MMLA will ensure the proper provision of services in accordance with the protocol, study contract and applicable regulations. A Home care Manager (Study Manager) will be assigned to the project in the U.S/Canada. MMLA complies with all applicable GCP and ICH guidelines and regulations, HIPAA and applicable federal, state and local regulations.

tabs.tab_content:
The Study Manager will ensure adequate training of all involved homecare study staff and will oversee study-related activities, timelines, adherence to budget, and quality assurance checks. MMLA will prepare a study-specific homecare training manual including study synopsis, clinician and nursing requirements, documentation, billing information and template of Physician Order Form.

The Study Manager will handle day-to-day interactions with the home care study personnel, the Sponsor /Investigator Site or Institution and their representatives. The Study Manager will provide status reports to the as mutually agreed upon (approximately weekly). MMLA will consolidate billings from each of the participating home care personel and will submit invoices to the Sponsor/Institution on a monthly basis. The Study Manager will be available 24/7 to respond to any issues arising during the course of the study.
